queries.query: what is Fohat and how does it press cosmic mind into primordial matter, settling scattered atoms into solid worlds
queries.note: Drafted from the Stanza III commentary; paraphrased away 'hardens the atoms', 'Cosmic Electricity', 'Web', and 'Svabhavat'. Kept the proper noun Fohat as a reader-honest anchor.

queries.query: the teaching that even a speck of mineral dust is itself alive, and that each successive Round of a manvantara brings one more of the elements into being
queries.note: Drafted from the 'ALL IS LIFE' passage; paraphrased away 'fiery lives', 'Devourers', and the exact One-Life phrasing. Kept manvantara/Rounds as reader-honest anchors.

queries.query: how the sequence of seven root-races and their vanished continents like Lemuria and Atlantis is read into the beast with seven heads in Revelation
queries.note: Drafted from the Apocalyptic passage equating the seven heads with continents and races; paraphrased the biblical quotation. Kept 'seven root-races', Lemuria, Atlantis as anchors.

queries.query: argument that towering prehistoric giants, not ordinary men, raised the huge megaliths of Stonehenge and Carnac, alongside old reports of oracle-giving stones
queries.note: Drafted from the Cyclopean-ruins section; paraphrased away 'Cyclopean', 'betyles', 'ophites', and the animated-stone quotations. Kept Stonehenge, Carnac, giants as anchors.

queries.query: why does evil have to exist at all, and can there be any good or growth in a world without it
queries.note: The Secret Doctrine treats evil as a force essential to good, but the necessity-of-evil question is answered across many traditions in the corpus.

queries.query: how a single point emerging within a circle can serve as the geometric root from which the whole ordered universe is generated
queries.note: Drawn from the Pythagorean Monad / Mathematical-Point passage, but the point-and-circle image of cosmic origination recurs in Pythagorean, Kabbalistic, and Hermetic sources too.
